_comment: Phase 4.7R5 classifier B (PROGRAMMING_DOMAIN_FALLBACK) dataset. Synthetic, hand-authored, no real user data. Each entry is a TEMPLATE FAMILY; split is by family. label 1 = PROGRAMMING (training-program design question: overload, volume, frequency, load, intensity, tempo, failure, exercise order, rest, structure), 0 = NOT_PROGRAMMING (adjacent domains: hypertrophy mechanism, strength, catalog, nutrition, recovery, body composition, supplements, safety, OOD). Not copied from any V1-V5 evaluation set; surface forms are intentionally paraphrastic (accented/unaccented VN, EN, mixed).
